verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's event-driven automation is limited to secrets-scanning workflows. Findings can be routed to Slack, Jira, email or webhooks, alerts can carry customized remediation messages, and continuous monitoring watches sources for leaked credentials. Pre-commit and pre-receive hooks automatically fail or block commits when secrets are found. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rule engine with event conditions and arbitrary actions, and routing appears to be an Enterprise feature. Missing for 10: a documented rule/trigger configuration model (conditions → actions), actions beyond notification and blocking, and hands-on or independent corroboration of alert-routing rules.
